# Exercise the generated wrapper in POSIX sh.
setup_workspace
exec grove add feature
exec grove switch shell-init --shell sh
cp stdout $WORK/wrapper.sh

exec sh -e $WORK/switch.sh
stdout '/workspace/feature'
! stderr .

exec sh -ec '. "$WORK/wrapper.sh"; grove add short-switch -s; test "$PWD" = "$WORK/workspace/short-switch"; grove switch -; test "$PWD" = "$WORK/workspace/main"; grove add long-switch --switch; test "$PWD" = "$WORK/workspace/long-switch"; grove switch -; test "$PWD" = "$WORK/workspace/main"'

! exec sh -c '. "$WORK/wrapper.sh"; unset GROVE_PREV_WORKTREE; grove switch -'
stderr '^no previous worktree$'
! stdout .

-- switch.sh --
. "$WORK/wrapper.sh"
grove switch feature
test "$PWD" = "$WORK/workspace/feature"
sh -c 'test "$GROVE_PREV_WORKTREE" = "$WORK/workspace/main"'
grove switch -
test "$PWD" = "$WORK/workspace/main"
grove switch -
test "$PWD" = "$WORK/workspace/feature"
pwd
